prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking, cinematic scene set in a mysterious, gothic garden at twilight. The central focus is on a pair of tall, glossy black leather boots with intricate lacing and metallic buckles, worn by a figure whose upper body is out of frame. The boots stand firmly on a reflective, cracked glass surface, creating a dramatic mirror image that enhances the surreal atmosphere. Surrounding the boots are dense, thorny rose bushes with large, dark, almost metallic black roses, their petals sharply defined and glistening with dew. Vivid, electric blue butterflies flutter around the scene, their wings glowing against the otherwise monochromatic, desaturated color palette. The background features hints of ornate, shadowy architecture, partially obscured by mist and overgrown foliage. The lighting is moody and high-contrast, with cool blue highlights and deep shadows, evoking a sense of intrigue and dark fantasy. The composition is symmetrical and tightly framed at a low angle, emphasizing the boots and their reflection, while the shallow depth of field keeps the focus on the foreground details, lending the image a hyper-real, almost dreamlike quality.
